class: When a user-facing text (a pinned template, a pre-filled value) changes, tests in OTHER files that copied the old literal keep asserting it; the builder's targeted run passes, and the stale assertion only fails in the full suite or in CI. Wider shape: a literal copied into a test is a second home of the text; the brief's 'search every test tree' rule is prose and is skipped.
mechanism: 2026-10-26, three times in one day: (1) row 25 reworded the Execute margin refusal - 5 tests in tests/execution/test_margin_gate.py still asserted 'Zerodha says this strategy needs ...' (caught by ci_local); (2) #537 F2 removed "Zerodha's figure is final" - tests/execution/test_safety_checks.py:149 still expected it (caught by ci_local); (3) ADR-192 shortened the Save As pre-fill - frontend/tests/draft-link.test.js:188 still expected 'NIFTY Oct condor copy' (caught by CI's frontend job, run 40333943898). Each builder ran targeted files only; the checkers did not grep for the old literal either.
fix: Mechanism due (third occurrence): a check that, for every pinned template whose text or hash changes in a diff (tests/errors/template_pins.json) and every changed string constant a test can copy, greps tests/, tests_app/, frontend/tests/ and frontend/e2e/ for the OLD rendered text and fails naming each hit; run by ci_local's test step or a repo test. Until built: briefs require the grep with the old value pasted (builder-brief.md rule 'A changed shown value is searched in every test tree') and the full frontend unit suite (~1 min) when a frontend text changes.

detection.note: ci_local's full test step and CI catch it after the build, costing a round (about 15-25 min each time today).
